hero.heading: Ancient Faith. Living Messiah. Southern California Community.

welcome.title: Welcome Home
welcome.body: Ohr HaTorah is a Messianic Jewish congregation in Orange County, California, celebrating Yeshua the Messiah through vibrant worship, biblical teaching, and genuine community.

values.title: Focused on Yeshua
values.body: We worship Yeshua the Messiah as Lord and King.

values.title: Jewish in Heritage
values.body: Proudly Messianic Jewish and faithful to our calling.

values.title: Family in Spirit
values.body: A community where everyone is known, loved, and valued.

quote.label: God's Torah
quote.text: "It is a Tree of Life [etz chaim] for those who take hold of it, and happy are those who uphold it. Its ways are ways of pleasantness, and all its paths are peace."

restorationQuote.label: Turn Us Back
restorationQuote.text: "Turn us back to you, HASHEM, and we shall be restored. Renew our lives as in days of old."

visit.title: We'd Love to Welcome You
visit.body: Join us in person in beautiful Orange County for Shabbat worship, Torah service, music, dance, teaching, and community.

newsletter.title: Stay Connected
newsletter.body: Encouragement, updates, and biblical teaching straight to your inbox.
